errors.evidence: The chart's title mentions 'ranking' and 'vulnerability', and the caption mentions 'assessments'. The description incorrectly assumes and states that the values represent the 'number of workers', which is an unsubstantiated interpretation of the data.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва различните категории работници
errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart. The categories are listed on the vertical axis, and the values are represented by the length of the bars along the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly swaps the roles of the axes.
The categories on the vertical axis are not listed in alphabetical order. They are sorted by their corresponding values in ascending order, from top to bottom.
The description uses the word 'height' ('височина') to describe the dimension of the horizontal bars. The more accurate term would be 'length' ('дължина'), as the bars extend horizontally.

The bar with the value 4,170 corresponds to the category 'Специалисти и експерти (високо и най-високо квалификационно равнище)', not 'Технически изпълнители (високо квалификационно равнище)' as stated in the description.

errors.text_span: Всички стълбове са подредени въз основа на стойността на броя на работниците, от най-висок до най-нисък постигнат брой.
errors.evidence: The bars are sorted in ascending order of value from top to bottom (from 1,390 to 6,284), not in descending order ('from highest to lowest') as the description claims.

The description does not mention the value axis (horizontal axis) at all. It fails to note that this axis has no label or units, and it does not describe its scale, which are requirements of the prompt.
